author: ETA PRIME
description:
Upgrading The New Steam Machine! In this video, we are doing a complete teardown and full upgrade on the all-new Valve Steam Machine! By default, this ultra-compact gaming PC ships with 16GB of system RAM, but today we are testing its limits by pushing it all the way to 64GB of DDR5 RAM and swapping the stock storage for a massive 4TB Kingston FURY Renegade NVMe M.2 SSD
